O. Henry, Short Fiction.
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/o-henry/short-fiction

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- O. Henry, the annotator and author, died 1910.

First publication of the text used: 1883 to 1910 (SE colophon: 'Short Fiction was compiled from short stories written between 1883 and 1910 by O. Henry.').

Why this is public domain:
- United States: the text was first published in 1883 to 1910, before 1931, and the edition's rights statement below says it is in the United States public domain.
- Country of origin: not needed. Every person whose words are in the text died by 1925 (last death: 1910), so the text is public domain in every country with a term of life + 100 years or less, whatever its country of first publication.

The edition's own statement of rights (from the repository's content.opf):
"The source text and artwork in this ebook are believed to be in the United States public domain; that is, they are believed to be free of copyright restrictions in the United States. They may still be copyrighted in other countries, so users located outside of the United States must check their local laws before using this ebook. The creators of, and contributors to, this ebook dedicate their contributions to the worldwide public domain via the terms in the [CC0 1.0 Universal Public Domain Dedication](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/)."

Sources of these facts:
- SE colophon: Short Fiction was compiled from short stories written between 1883 and 1910 by O. Henry.
- Wikidata Q172788 (O. Henry), P570 = 1910-06-05 and 1910-01-01
